# stripe_metronome_customer_revenue_configuration (Resource)

A customer-scoped revenue provider configuration. Import as customer_id/configuration_id. Destroy archives only this configuration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration` (Dynamic, Sensitive) Provider-specific configuration object from CustomerBillingProviderConfigurationInput or CustomerRevenueSystemConfigurationInput. Server-populated keys may be omitted from HCL. Terraform still stores this value in state; use an encrypted, access-controlled backend.
- `customer_id` (String)
- `provider_name` (String) Maps to Metronome billing_provider or revenue provider. Terraform reserves the attribute name provider.

### Optional

- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Set false and apply before archiving this configuration.
- `delivery_method_id` (String) Existing delivery method ID. The API returns this after creation.

### Read-Only

- `delivery_method` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tax_provider` (String)
